verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce provides the payment rails (tokenization, mandates, passkey step-up, Trusted Agent Protocol, MCP server) that could power in-chat checkout for AI agents generally, and docs explicitly describe 'AI-initiated transactions' and agent purchase-intent flows. However, no evidence names or demonstrates live integration with specific chat/assistant surfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot) — the product page itself flags 'This product is in the process of development and deployment,' and the toolkit/MCP references are generic developer-facing building blocks rather than shown live checkout inside named assistants. Missing for 10: concrete evidence of shipped/working checkout flows inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot specifically, and independent confirmation of real-world in-chat purchases.
